family: All Boolean sign truth tables on uniform cubes n=1,2,3,4, including irrelevant variables
domain: masks 0..2^(2^n)-1; bit x means f(x)=+1, unset means -1; coordinate zero is least significant
symmetry: None; output complement and input signed-permutation equivalents all retained
trees: One relevant root query; independently stop or query one remaining relevant coordinate in each physical child; depth at most two. Root-only trees included.
metrics: r1=min_i Delta_i H/Inf_i; r2=min_T (H-E_leaf H)/(I-E_leaf I); maximize r1-r2
arithmetic: integer FWHT, exact integer influence; outward rational atanh log bounds rounded to fixed point 2^80; all ratio/gap comparisons cross-multiplied integers
certificate: Global maximum upper bound plus attained witness lower bound; exact ties handled by intervals, never floats
